script_text: Stop, Taurus! The celestial sphere is igniting a critical juncture in your journey today. Venus, your ruling planet in earthy Taurus, is transiting your 7th House of Partnerships, forming a harmonious trine with Jupiter in your 11th House of Friendships, while a square from Saturn in your 4th House of Home creates domestic tension. In love, this trine fosters warm social bonds; single Taureans may attract a promising connection through group events, but couples should address household stresses to avoid friction. Career-wise, Jupiter's trine brings lucrative opportunities through networking or collaborative ventures, yet Saturn's square advises grounding ambitions in practicality. Blessing: An unexpected insight from a friend could resolve a long-standing issue. Follow for tomorrow's reading to navigate the cosmic waves ahead.
